description: A vertical path of numbered steps. Done steps have a tick, the next step is highlighted, and open steps are dimmed

legend.description: Description text under the title, above the steps (optional)

nextLabel.description: Text shown after the label of each step with the status "next", for example "your next step" (optional)

steps.description: The steps, from first to last. The widget numbers them.

status.description: done: the step has a tick. next: the step is highlighted. open: the step is dimmed.

cardKey.description: Key of the card that opens when the user clicks the step (optional). The link works in the app and in exported sites. In exported documents (AsciiDoc and PDF), the widget is an image, so the step is not a link.

title: Report
